owners.title: Your property, fully visible
owners.lead: Every owner under a Muktasabat management agreement gets a private portal with live figures from our property-management system — no waiting for month-end emails.
features: Rent collected, our fees, maintenance and your net income — month by month, building by building.
Detailed owner statements you can download as Excel or save as PDF for your accountant.
See which units are leased or vacant, who the tenant is and when each lease ends.
Every lease and your management agreement, with their registration status on Ejar.
Upcoming and overdue instalments, with our follow-up on late payments.
Every maintenance and operating cost, with vendor and date, before it reaches your statement.
process: We inspect the property, price it against the market and sign a management agreement registered on Ejar.
We market vacant units, screen tenants and register every lease on Ejar.
We collect rent, follow up on late payments and handle maintenance within the limits you approve.
You follow everything live in the owner portal and receive a monthly statement with your net payout.
faq: Who gets access to the owner portal?
Every owner with an active property-management agreement with Muktasabat. Your account manager sends you an activation link by email or WhatsApp.
They come straight from the system our team uses every day, so payments, expenses and lease changes appear as soon as they are recorded.
Yes. Any month or full year can be downloaded as an Excel-compatible file or printed to PDF.
Are my leases registered on Ejar?
Yes. Each lease and your management agreement shows its Ejar registration status in the portal.
Fees follow your management agreement — usually a percentage of rent collected — and every deduction is itemised on your statement.

faq.title: Everything you want to know before you start
items: Muktasabat Real Estate (شركة مكتسبات العقارية) is a licensed real estate office in Saudi Arabia specialising in exclusive property marketing, brokerage and property management.
How do I find an apartment or villa for rent?
Browse the listings page and filter by property type, city, district and price — or leave a request and we'll send you matching properties on WhatsApp as soon as they're available.
What does your property management service include?
Marketing vacant units, tenant selection, lease documentation on Ejar, rent collection and arrears follow-up, maintenance, and monthly financial reports available to the owner in the owner portal.
Yes. Every lease we sign is documented on the Ejar platform, and owners can follow the documentation status from their portal.
How can I find out my property's rental value?
Send us the location and size of your property from the contact page and we'll reply within one business day with a free estimate based on real transactions in the district — no obligation.
Do you work with owners and investors?
Yes. We market and manage properties for owners and investors, with Ejar-documented leases and monthly financial reports in the owner portal.
What are your office hours and how do I reach you?
Saturday to Thursday, 9 AM to 9 PM. Call 920007039, message us on WhatsApp, or use the contact form on this site.

dataManagement.title: Data management
dataManagement.subtitle: Bulk export, correct and re-import owners, properties, units, tenants, contracts and every lookup — validated strictly before anything is saved.
dataManagement.exportHelp: One workbook with a sheet per entity ({records} records), drop-downs bound to the lookups, live name columns beside every link, a Lookups sheet and a data dictionary.
dataManagement.lookupsIncluded: {n} lookup lists are included in the Lookups sheet.
dataManagement.step1: Edit the exported workbook — fix rows, or add new rows with a blank ID (or NEW-1, NEW-2… to link them from other sheets).
dataManagement.step2: Validate: the whole file is checked — types, formats, lookups, links, duplicates and business rules. Every problem is listed with its sheet, row and column.
dataManagement.step3: Apply: only a file with zero errors can be imported, and it is saved in a single all-or-nothing transaction.
dataManagement.fixErrorsFirst: Fix every error in the file and validate again
dataManagement.truncated: Showing the first {n} errors. Fix these and validate again to see the rest.
dataManagement.hasErrors: {n} errors found — nothing can be imported until the file is clean.
dataManagement.noChanges: The file is valid and matches the system — nothing to import.
dataManagement.readyToApply: The file is valid — {n} records will be created or updated.
